tools.name: get_live_scores
tools.description: Return currently in-progress games across all sports (or one sport). Each row carries home/away teams and scores, league, a derived status, the live clock/period marker, and data_age_seconds (source freshness at serve time). Keyless, free.

tools.name: get_scores_by_date
tools.description: Return all events on a calendar date (UTC, "YYYY-MM-DD"), optionally filtered to one sport. Same unified schema and freshness field as get_live_scores. Use for finals, fixtures, and a full day board. Keyless, free.

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Return betting lines for a league's current scoreboard: point spread, over/under total, and home/away moneyline (single-book, DraftKings via ESPN), plus each team's win/loss record and the game status. Call with a league token (nfl, nba, nhl, mlb, epl, "la liga", ncaaf, ucl, ...). Lines appear once

tools.name: get_matchup
tools.description: One-call betting-research card for a SINGLE game: each team's recent form (last-5 result string, W-L record, and current streak), the head-to-head season series (series score + completed meetings), the against-the-spread record (US sports, once enough games exist), and ESPN's win-probability (US spo

tools.name: get_injuries
tools.description: Return the current injury report for a league: player, team, position, status (Out, Day-To-Day, ...) and the latest short report note with its update time. Optionally filter to one team by name. Use before reading a betting line from get_odds. Keyless, free.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Return the latest headlines for a league (headline, one-line summary, publish time, link). Use for breaking context such as suspensions or trades. Not an injury list: call get_injuries for that. Keyless, free.

tools.name: list_odds_leagues
tools.description: List the league tokens get_odds understands (US majors + top soccer leagues) with their sport and ESPN path. Keyless, free.

tools.name: list_sports
tools.description: List the sport filters the score tools understand (canonical labels + common aliases like nba/nfl/nhl/mlb). Keyless, free.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_odds, get_matchup · Private data: get_odds, get_matchup, list_odds_leagues · Public sink: get_news.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_odds, get_matchup · Private data: get_odds, get_matchup, list_odds_leagues · Public sink: get_news

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_sports" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List the sport filters this server understands (canonical labels + common aliases like nba/nfl/nhl/mlb). Keyless, free." → after: "List the sport filters the score tools understand (canonical labels + common aliases like nba/nfl/nhl/mlb). Keyless, free."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
